title: WeakRef, FinalizationRegistry, and WeakMap cleanup
hook: WeakMap keys are weakly held — dropping the key object allows GC. WeakRef lets you peek at an object without preventing collection. FinalizationRegistry runs a callback after GC — useful for cache bookkeeping, not for critical cleanup.

blocks.text: **WeakMap**: keys must be objects; held weakly — no iteration API. When key is unreachable, entry disappears. **WeakSet** same for membership. **WeakRef**: `deref()` returns object or `undefined` if collected. **FinalizationRegistry**: register object → callback after GC (best-effort, may never run). Not a destructor — do not release file handles here.

entries.plainDefinition: Map with weak object keys; no size/keys iteration.
Non-owning reference; deref may return undefined.

blocks.text: Attach metadata to DOM nodes or ORM entities without leaking memory when nodes leave the tree. Redis connection pool side tables can use WeakMap keyed by request context. Misusing FinalizationRegistry for closing files races with process exit.

blocks.title: Finalizers are unreliable
blocks.body: GC may never run under memory pressure patterns — always use try/finally for resources.

blocks.title: Pitfalls to avoid
blocks.body: Using FinalizationRegistry to close DB connections. Expecting WeakMap.size. Storing primitives as WeakMap keys.

blocks.text: ECMAScript weak collections do not expose enumeration — prevents GC timing attacks. In Node 14+, FinalizationRegistry available. Pattern: WeakMap for instance metadata; strong Map only for IDs you control with TTL.

blocks.title: What gets you rejected in interviews
blocks.body: Uses finalizer for resource cleanup. Thinks WeakMap iterates keys. Cannot explain weak vs strong.

interviewTakeaways: WeakMap keys weakly held — no enumeration.
FinalizationRegistry is best-effort post-GC — not destructor.
60s: WeakMap for object-keyed metadata without leak. WeakRef non-owning peek. Finalizers unreliable — use try/finally for resources.
commonPitfalls: Weak: Map keyed by DOM nodes — leak.
Strong: WeakMap for per-element data + explain no iteration.
